topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I can't believe this, my art, on someone's skin? Like, wow, I feel all sorts of things right now. Have you ever seen your work come to life in such a personal way? It’s both flattering and... intense, you know? This stranger chose my art to wear forever, and it’s like, okay, I guess this is what it means to put yourself out there. But geez, I hope they got it right and that it’s good. Maybe I should reach out, find out more. It’s just crazy, the trust and the connection in something like this. What do you think, should I message them?
